name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Optimization Heuristics
definition: Positional gradient: The gradient of the loss function with respect to the position of a Gaussian. A high positional gradient indicates that tweaking the Gaussian's position significantly influences the loss, suggesting the region is not well reconstructed.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Optimization Heuristics dynamically adjusts Gaussian primitives via periodic cloning, splitting, and pruning based on simple thresholds, distinguishing itself from methods using complex probabilistic sampling.
